name: Coohom
shortDescription: Uploads a floor plan and builds an editable 3D scene. A free Basic account is available.
longDescription: Coohom lets you upload a floor plan you already have, or describe one, and then builds a 3D scene you can edit and render. The help center says a free Basic account is available. See their site for paid plan prices.
pricingNotes: A free Basic account is available. See their site for paid plan prices.
bestFor: An uploaded floor plan that should become an editable 3D scene

notIdealFor: A one-photo staging job with no plan
strength: Coohom turns an uploaded floor plan into an editable 3D scene you can render.
weakness: A free basic account is listed, and the public price text does not include a paid dollar amount.
